root_cause: the helper reflects into StyledTextRenderer.lineSizes (LineSizeInfo[]); the viewport renderer keeps sizes in StyledTextLineStore int lanes (width[], UNMEASURED=-1) since 2026-10-13
fix: measuredLines counts store.width entries != -1; the 4096-line window assertion is unchanged

root_cause: not a Java2DCanvas leak: the target GC is on an Image, and upstream win32 GC keeps a replay log for image GCs (GC.operations, data.reapplicable) that holds copies of every clip Region (SetClippingRegionOperation) and drawn Image (ImageOperation.setCopyOfImage) until the GC is disposed; creation stacks in probe/probe.log
fix: the residue check runs after disposing the target GC, so it measures what outlives the GC (still 0 required)

root_cause: M3FilterRow applies a field after DELAY via timerExec; the assertion ran synchronously after setText (the clearing step two lines later already waits)
fix: waitFor(...) before the assertion, as for the clearing step

root_cause: IllegalAccessException: package-private Tree.pageBatchThreshold invoked without setAccessible; after the fix the real assertion fails: 'only an operation larger than one screen is batched' expected 1 batch, got 0
fix: setAccessible(true); the batching assertion stays open (see below)

root_cause: Tree holds 22 TreeItem facades for the first screen of a page-source tree after open; answerPageNode (TVN_GETDISPINFO, id == -1 rows only) is therefore bypassed. Same in swt.widget.mode=original, so not the viewport mode: the Tree residency/frontier path materializes rows that the 2026-10-13 page-source design (d5db98c757, 95b4e750c2) expects unmaterialized
fix: needs a Tree-side change (page-source rows must stay facade-free through the frontier); not small or local

root_cause: same root cause: 29 facades instead of 22 after expand (the loading child is materialized instead of being a mask bit)
VirtualPageSource never swaps an evicted block out (SWAPPED_OUT == 0) while scrolling 26,000 rows; eviction is driven by facade-free page answers, which the Tree bypasses (same root cause)
pageBatches stays 0 for an expand larger than one screen; page batching is counted in the page-answer path (same root cause)
